decisions.reason: As a certified product close to our established heat-exchanger business, it is too early to abandon this low-risk adjacent option after only one year with limited market feedback.
The reported strong quality reputation and major market share in water cooling systems already provide positive evidence that this marine offering is realizing value worth continuing.
This marine cooling unit builds directly on our existing capabilities, and with uncertainty still unresolved after launch, keeping it preserves upside at likely modest continuation cost.
The compact oil cooler fits our core engineering and customer base, and there is not yet enough negative evidence to justify closing this option so soon after launch.
A finned tube for air coolers complements our broader thermal solutions portfolio, so maintaining it on the market is a sensible option while demand information accumulates.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are closely aligned with our technical know-how and installed-base business, making it rational to keep this promising adjacent option open.
